sources.name: Directories (animalia.tn, tunisievet.com, petzone-live.com, expat.com, med.tn)
sources.note: Aggregators, used only as leads, never as source_url. animalia.tn lists 'Experts Veterinarians VETS' (30 Rue de Cordoue, Manar 1, +216 98 177 947, website vetsclinics.com) as 'Ouvert 24h/24' every day, but the same page also shows 'Fermé'; the vetsclinics.com site could not be opened with WebFetch (URL not in provenance set), so the 24 h claim is unverified. animalia.tn blog 'urgence 24h' article contains placeholder phone numbers and is not trustworthy.

sources.name: La Presse (lapresse.tn)
sources.note: Opened: names 'Vets Réseaux d'experts' running a mobile veterinary unit working around the clock; no addresses or phones. Not listed.

notes: Zero publishable entries from this run. No official Tunisian source (chamber, ministry, ENMV hospital) offers a clinic list, duty rota or animal poison line that could be opened. Every clinic website tried was either blocked (robots: cliniqueveterinaire-elghazela.com) or refused by WebFetch as outside the provenance set (vetsclinics.com, petscarevet.com), so no clinic could be sourced from its own page; aggregator-only data was not used per runbook section 2. Centre Anti-Poison de Tunis serves humans; no animal poison line found. Leads for a follow-up run (phones from aggregator listings, UNVERIFIED, not published): VETS Experts Veterinarians Manar 1 Tunis (vetsclinics.com, 24 h claim to verify on own site); Pets Care La Soukra (petscarevet.com); Klania Vet Clinic La Soukra; Clinique Vétérinaire Les Pins La Marsa; Clinique Vétérinaire des Acacias La Marsa; C.H.A.T Centre Hospitalier Animal de Tunis (La Marsa/Carthage); Pets'Doctor Ennasr 2 Ariana; Beloved PetsClinic El Aouina; Clinique Vétérinaire Hammamet; Aura clinique vétérinaire Hammamet; Clinique Vétérinaire Mzabi / Sahloul Sousse; Clinique La Falaise Monastir; Djerba: My Vet Djerba, Dr Sellaouti. Left: all of Tunisia. A run with WebFetch able to open clinic domains (or a user-approved URL list) is needed.
